name: cx-medicare-levy-surcharge
description: Medicare levy surcharge for Christmas Island individuals for 2026-27 (Australian external territory, Commonwealth law applies). Covers the ordinary single adult, family and relationship periods and the surviving spouse branch, annual income for surcharge purposes (I), the separate taxable-income and reportable-benefits charge bases, hospital cover and prescribed-person day sets, reportable superannuation contributions, the 2026-27 concessional contributions cap and carry-forward excess, and validation of a chosen personal super deduction. Use for Christmas Island MLS, private hospital cover, surcharge tiers, reportable super or concessional cap questions. Split from cx-income-tax; source-cited draft, does not complete a return.
